title: Carlos struggles to find the crash site in Moment of Contact

tellings.quote: And to me, if he were a liar, he would have said, "Here it is." But he gets there and he goes, "It wasn't here. In fact, the landscape has changed."

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a scene in Moment of Contact, a 2022 documentary by filmmaker James Fox about a reported crash of an unknown craft near the town of Varginha, Brazil. In it a witness named Carlos Dosoza goes back to look for the crash site, and according to Michels he cannot find it and says, "It wasn't here. In fact, the landscape has changed." Michels says this convinces him, because a liar would simply have pointed and said "here it is."
